heading.title: Parties to Notes, Bills and Cheques.

article.title: Liability of drawee of cheque.
article.content: The drawee of a cheque having sufficient funds of the drawer in his hands properly applicable to the payment of such cheque must pay the cheque when duly required so to do, and , in default of such payment, must compensate the drawer for any loss or damage caused by such default.
article.html:
31Liability of drawee of cheque.

Section 31 · Chapter III · page 12 of the Act

The drawee of a cheque having sufficient funds of the drawer in his hands properly applicable to the payment of such cheque must pay the cheque when duly required so to do, and , in default of such payment, must compensate the drawer for any loss or damage caused by such default.
